summary: Open. The residue of de Weger's conjecture after everything proved: no collision C(n,k) = C(m,l) (2 ≤ k ≤ n/2, 2 ≤ l ≤ m/2, k < l) with (k,l) outside the nine solved pairs, not of the shapes (n−1,k+1), (n−1,k+2), (n−2,k+1), with n > 10^6 and C(n,k) > 10^60. Nothing published is left to peel; what is missing is a bound uniform in (k,l). A proof closes the whole --h2 branch and, with MRSTT Theorem 1.3, Singmaster's conjecture.
